lines: Mother of stainless art, of new great making, full-bodied one —
five-faced Father, splendor hidden — may the Heart flash forth, deathless kin beyond all, for me.
sanskrit_cite: vimalakalāśrayābhinavasṛṣṭimahā jananī bharitatanuś ca pañcamukhaguptarucir janakaḥ | tadubhayayāmalasphuritabhāvavisargamayaṃ hṛdayam anuttarāmṛtakulaṃ mama saṃsphuratāt

lines: Wide spreads the Tantrāloka — and none at all can dive;
so hear this Tantrasāra, in plain words composed.
sanskrit_cite: vitatas tantrāloko vigāhituṃ naiva śakyate sarvaiḥ | ṛjuvacanaviracitam idaṃ tu tantrasāraṃ tataḥ śṛṇuta

lines: by Śambhunātha Sun's feet-fall light: gather it for Maheśa-worship.
Knowledge frees — opposing bondage-cause ignorance, twofold:
intellect-seated doubt and wrong-conviction, person-seated churning thought —
that last, saṃsāra's root. Initiation may wash the personal —
but needs decided shun-and-take; so deciding knowledge leads,
and practiced, kills the personal too — practice ends thought-free.
Pure knowing only — Lord-spoken scripture frees altogether.
sanskrit_cite: iha jñānaṃ mokṣakāraṇaṃ bandhanimittasya ajñānasya virodhakatvāt dvividhaṃ ca ajñānaṃ buddhigataṃ pauruṣaṃ ca tatra buddhigatam aniścayasvabhāvam viparītaniścayātmakaṃ ca pauruṣam tu vikalpasvabhāvam saṃkucitaprathātmakam tad eva ca mūlakāraṇam saṃsārasya iti vakṣyāmo malanirṇaye tatra pauruṣam ajñānaṃ dīkṣādinā nivartetāpi kiṃ tu dīkṣāpi buddhigate anadhyavasāyātmake ajñāne sati na sambhavati heyopādeyaniścayapūrvakatvāt tattvaśuddhiśivayojanārūpāyāḥ dīkṣāyāḥ iti adhyavasāyaātmakaṃ buddhiniṣṭham eva jñānam pradhānam tad eva ca abhyasyamānaṃ pauruṣam api ajñānaṃ nihanti vikalpasaṃvidabhyāsasya avikalpāntatāparyavasānāt hy ātmā vikalpāsaṃkucitsaṃvitprakāśarūpaḥ śivasvabhāvaḥ iti sarvathā samastavastuniṣṭham samyaṅniścayātmakaṃ jñānam upādeyam tac ca śāstrapūrvakam śāstram ca parameśvarabhāṣitam eva pramāṇam aparaśāstroktānām arthānāṃ tatra vaiviktyena abhyupagamāt tadarthātiriktayuktisiddhanirūpaṇāc ca tena aparāgamoktam jñānam tāvataḥ eva bandhāt vimocakam na sarvasmāt sarvasmāt tu vimocakam parameśvaraśāstram pañcasrotomayam daśāṣṭādaśavasvaṣṭabhedabhinnam tato 'pi sarvasmāt sāram ṣaḍardhaśāstrāṇi tebhyo 'pi mālinīvijayam tadantargataś cārthaḥ saṃkalayya aśakyo nirūpayitum na ca anirūpitavastutattvasya muktatvam mocakatvam vā śuddhasya jñānasyaiva tathārūpatvāt iti svabhyastajñānamūlatvāt parapuruṣārthasya tatsiddhaye idam ārabhyate ajñānaṃ kila bandhahetuḥ uditaḥ śāstre malaṃ tat smṛtam pūrṇajñānakalodaye tad akhilam nirmūlatāṃ gacchati dhvastāśeṣamalātmasaṃvidudaye mokṣaḥ ca tena amunā śāstreṇa prakaṭīkaromi nikhilam yaj jñeyatattvam bhavet

lines: Own-nature alone most adoptable — light-nature of all, since non-light cannot be nature;
one, autonomous, everywhere. Its freedom bliss, its wonder will,
its light awareness, its grasp knowing, all-form-fitness action —
resting in own bliss, Śiva — contracting, called atom; showing again, with means or without, threefold, fourfold, to spread it full.
sanskrit_cite: tatra iha svabhāvaḥ eva paramopādeyaḥ saḥ ca sarvabhāvānām prakāśarūpaḥ eva aprakāśasya svabhāvatānupapatteḥ saḥ ca nānekaḥ prakāśasya taditarasvabhāvānupraveśāyoge svabhāvabhedābhāvāt deśakālāv api ca asya na bhedakau tayor api tatprakāśasvabhāvatvāt iti ekaḥ eva prakāśaḥ saḥ eva ca saṃvit arthaprakāśarūpā hi saṃvit sarveṣām atra avivādaḥ eva saḥ ca prakāśaḥ na paratantraḥ prakāśyatā eva hi pāratantryam prakāśyatā ca prakāśāntarāpekṣitā eva na ca prakāśāntaram kiṃcit asti iti svatantraḥ ekaḥ prakāśaḥ svātantryād eva ca deśakālākārāvacchedavirahāt vyāpakaḥ nityaḥ sarvākāranirākārasvabhāvaḥ tasya ca svātantryam ānandaśaktiḥ taccamatkāraḥ icchāśaktiḥ prakāśarūpatā cicchaktiḥ āmarśātmakatā jñānaśaktiḥ ity evam mukhyābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ yukto 'pi vastutaḥ icchājñānakriyāśaktiyuktaḥ anavacchinnaḥ prakāśaḥ nijānandaviśrāntaḥ śivarūpaḥ saḥ eva svātantryāt ātmānam saṃkucitam avabhāsayan aṇuḥ iti ucyate punar api ca svātmānam svatantratayā prakāśayati yena anavacchinnaprakāśaśivarūpatayaiva prakāśate tatrāpi svātantryavaśāt anupāyam eva svātmānam prakāśayati sopāyaṃ vā sopāyatve 'pi icchā vā jñānam vā kriyā vā abhyupāyaḥ iti traividhyam śāmbhavaśāktāṇavabhedena samāveśasya tatra caturvidham api etad rūpam krameṇa atra upadiśyate ātmā prakāśavapuḥ eṣaḥ śivaḥ svatantraḥ svātantryanarmarabhasena nijam svarūpam saṃchādya yat punar api prathayeta pūrṇam tat ca kramākramavaśāt athavā tribhedāt
